label: Household income from photovoltaic generation (2020)
caveat: The 2020 questionnaire explicitly defines the past-year measure as both household-use value and grid-sale revenue. This is a household-level, single-wave measure; do not interpret it as cash income only or combine with general business income.

source_fields.unit: past-year Yuan amount; includes value used at home and electricity sold to the national grid
source_fields.mapping_status: candidate; official 2020 questionnaire/Codebook item located; route and denominator must be verified in approved data
